content.title: How EU tariffs could impact the global shipping industry
content.description:
Container bookings more than doubled the week of May 12th after the US and China agreed to a 90-day trade truce. Semiramis Paliou, CEO of Diana Shipping, joins Catalysts to discuss possible EU tariffs, the shipping industry, and why some shipping sub-sectors will be less exposed to tariff risk.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Catalysts here.
